why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Spekter Games homepage Go to the official site at Spekter Games and find the Spekter Agency section.
2 Step 2 : Start the game on Telegram or LINE Use the Play on Telegram or Play on LINE button in that section to open Spekter Agency in the messaging app you prefer.
3 Step 3 : Play and level up Complete runs and progress your character. Spark points build up in the background, and the earning rate rises with your level.
4 Step 4 : Follow the news channel Join the Spekter Agency news channel on Telegram for the studio's updates.
